name: symbol_counts
description: Count explicitly supplied symbol facts by kind, with optional kind filtering.
source:
function analyze(data, request)
    allowed = Set(get(request, "kinds", String[]))
    counts = Dict{String,Int}()
    for symbol in data["symbols"]
        kind = symbol["kind"]
        isempty(allowed) || kind in allowed || continue
        counts[kind] = get(counts, kind, 0) + 1
    end
    Dict("counts_by_kind" => counts, "selected_symbols" => sum(values(counts); init=0))
end
selftest() = analyze(Dict("symbols" => []), Dict())["selected_symbols"] == 0
